verdict.rationale: Discord documents Threads (including Private Threads) as a way to branch a conversation off a channel's main feed, so conversations can be organized under threads. The main feed persists alongside them, so organization is optional rather than every conversation being topic-scoped, and nothing documents catch-up features. missing for 10: evidence that every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread (threads are optional branches off the main feed), catch-up or unread-summary tooling for busy channels, independent hands-on corroboration that threads make catching up efficient.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can catch up on busy channels efficiently because every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread

citations.quote: A Thread is a quick way to branch a conversation off of a channel’s main feed without removing it from the channel itself.
Private Threads are now available for all servers!
